content:
在向開發者推出 macOS 27.2 beta 3 一天後，Apple 現在也向已登記參與公測計劃的用戶推出相同版本。以下為更新內容。

macOS 27.2 Public Beta 2 Now Available

After a two-week hiatus, Apple yesterday seeded developers with macOS 27.2 beta 3, continuing its testing as it prepares for a launch in the coming weeks.

While the iOS 27.2 beta has brought some new features, including a redesigned Health app, a dual-camera mode for group FaceTime calls, and Apple TV profiles in the TV app, macOS 27.2 is comparatively bland, with its focus being on adding support for five new languages to Siri AI.

As Apple announced at last month's iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo event, Siri AI will soon be expanding its language support to include French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish, in addition to the existing English.

The macOS 27.2 public beta 2 release carries the same build number, 26B5101f, as yesterday's version.

To join Apple's free public beta program, visit beta.apple.com.

Did you find any new features in today's public beta? Let us know in the comments.
